name: Zacchaeus
summary: A rich chief tax collector in Jericho who climbed a tree to see Jesus. Jesus stayed at his house, and Zacchaeus said he would give half his goods to the poor.

key_moments.title: Up in a Sycamore Tree
key_moments.description: Zacchaeus was too short to see Jesus over the crowd, so he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore tree. Jesus looked up, called him by name, and said He must stay at his house that day, and Zacchaeus hurried down and welcomed Him with joy.

key_moments.title: Salvation Comes to His House
key_moments.description: The people grumbled that Jesus had gone to be the guest of a sinner. Zacchaeus stood and said he would give half his goods to the poor and pay back four times anything he had taken falsely, and Jesus said that salvation had come to his house that day.
